findings.message: This competency's isPartOf identifier matches no CompetencyFramework in this payload or the documents supplied, although this run can see one (https://credentialengineregistry.org/resources/ce-417cf79c-29ee-4c0e-9f4e-2d4558d4de3d). If this competency belongs to that framework, this identifier is the wrong one.

rule.citation: ceasn:isPartOf is defined as "Competency framework that this competency is a part of" (CTDL-ASN schema), and the CTDL Handbook states: "In the Registry, Competency Frameworks and their member Competencies are published in the same JSON-LD Graph". A member competency whose isPartOf identifier matches no framework in its own payload very likely carries the wrong identifier.
